R0056.title: Fake Reviews
R0056.definition: A seller purchases fake positive reviews to boost product reputation or search ranking weight.
R0056.description: Sellers collude with buyers through low-price orders, empty package shipments, or virtual deliveries to generate fake transactions and bulk positive reviews, boosting store credibility or product rankings.
R0056.influence: Undermines platform fairness and distorts ranking algorithms.

references.title: Ji'an Dismantles Order Brushing and Fake Review Black Industry Chain

observables: A store sees a sharp short-term surge in positive reviews, with clustered timing and highly similar review text
Orders backing the reviews are low-price, empty-package, or virtual deliveries with anomalous logistics trajectories
Reviewing accounts are newly registered or low-activity, with mechanical reviewing behavior and concentrated IPs or devices
Reviews within the same batch are templated, with a high repetition rate of keywords
